$comment: Public profile fields on a native user. Team selects ticked users; post credit reads the same user independently of that tick. The job title is not an account role. These public fields are the only person data a view reads; in particular an absent publicEmail means no email link, never the account's login email. Targets are shown with a count and never refused (18/11/2026 and 19/11/2026).

nextjs.owes: a count as the editor types that notes a title past about 60 characters and notes more strongly one past 120, never refused

wordpress.owes: a count as the editor types that notes a title past about 60 characters and notes more strongly one past 120, never refused

nextjs.owes: role at the top of the record in place of profile.roleTitle, with a target of 80 characters, shown with a count and never refused

wordpress.owes: a target of 80 characters, shown with a count and never refused; the author box reads the credited user's public job title, not an account role

fields.name: bio
fields.label: Short biography
fields.description: A few sentences, shown on the team card and in the author box.

fields.name: publicEmail

fields.description: Optional public contact address. If empty, draw nothing; never use the login email instead.
